station: FFS Station C8 / related FFS cameras
description: Human-verified reference photos for species calibration. Expected label is the canonical species_common string.

examples.notes: Long thick dark tail ≈ body length; longitudinal dark stripes on back breaking into flank spots; coarse grey-buff coat; facial mask / pale patches near eyes; often on ground at night in leaf litter (Cuddeback FFS sites).
Grizzled salt-and-pepper grey coat with NO dark neck stripe; bushy tapering mongoose tail (shorter/thicker base than palm civet); may appear singly or in pairs on leaf litter day or night.
Tiny hunched ungulate with spindly hoofed legs; brown coat with white flank stripes/spots and pale throat markings; not muntjac, not cat, not civet.

Long upright dark-tipped ears; grizzled brown/grey coat; often dark nape; short pale-underside tail; crouch or hop on leaf litter — not chevrotain (no white flank stripes, not hoofed spindly deer legs).
